fact: ECOWAS SIGTEL's regional inventory lists one Internet Exchange Point in Mali, Mali IX (MLIX) in Bamako, among 14 in the ECOWAS member states; no member count or traffic is given. The page carries no date, so as_of is its published date.
Internet Society Pulse's IXP Tracker lists 1 active exchange point in Mali with 7 members as of November 2026.
The African IXP Association's undated list of exchange points, retrieved 2026-11-09, names for Mali: MLIX, Bamako.
